caveats: Two samples per arm are directional ABBA evidence, not a confidence interval.
Per-op collect barriers change execution plan; do not sum them as lazy-pipeline contribution.
FineWeb uses stand-in perplexity; real KenLM dependencies were not present.
Only route hits proven in independent target probes may be used as attribution.
AD strict Typed is not scalar value-cache S; report separately.

isolated_operators.scope: One-column isolated original-operator execution, complete output materialization and to_arrow; excludes checkpoint loading, plan creation, Ray startup and hashing. One partition, four-CPU budget. Not pure kernel and not lazy-pipeline contribution.
isolated_operators.sample_policy: Initial ABBA2samplesperarm; another complete ABBA when either sampleCV>5%, retaining allsamples; final unstable/no-gain results remain reported.
excluded_attempts: isolated-l1 launcher revision lookup failed before container launch
isolated-full-capture-fineweb10GiB long-lived stage process OOM; replaced by full-v2 fresh-stage capture
old chained collect().to_arrow() N L1 caused second-terminal fallback and is excluded from runtime gate
isolated-ad-s1-R-ALL-r1-1-R10GiB control OOM; replaced by all-new16GiB full ABBA
isolated_operators.terminal_protocol: One public to_arrow() terminal completely executes and materializes the projected one-column result; no chained collect()/to_arrow() replay.

ad_baseline_correction.scope: AD results only; original measured samples retained
